This report validates each layer of the DuckLake pipeline using
[pointblank](https://posit-dev.github.io/pointblank/).

```{python}
from validations.connection import get_connection
from validations.checks import (
    validate_daily_revenue,
    validate_raw_events,
    validate_stg_events,
)

con = get_connection()
```

## Raw Events

Checks the seed data in `raw.events`: non-null keys, known event types,
non-negative revenue, and a unique `event_id`.

```{python}
validate_raw_events(con)
```

## Staging Events

Checks `staging.stg_events`: null `event_id` rows were filtered upstream,
dates are populated, and revenue is non-negative.

```{python}
validate_stg_events(con)
```

## Daily Revenue

Checks `analytics.daily_revenue`: `event_date` is the unique grain, every
day has at least one user, and revenue is non-negative.

```{python}
validate_daily_revenue(con)
```

```{python}
con.disconnect()
```
